module.heading: Agricultural Infrastructure in Dothan
module.intro: Transportation networks and agricultural services in Dothan support a robust peanuts and cotton production system that connects local farms to broader markets. From grain elevators to input suppliers, the infrastructure surrounding agriculture here reflects decades of investment in the region's farming future. Modern additions to this infrastructure include RTK signal networks and data connectivity that enable precision farming at scale.

module.todayTieIn: For peanuts operations dealing with timely planting, precision guidance and variable-rate technology offer practical solutions that translate regional knowledge into field-level decisions. These tools help Dothan farmers do what they've always done—grow quality crops—with greater accuracy and less waste.
